questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: How much space should you keep between your car and a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of space between your car and a motorcycle. Even a small bump can cause a motorcycle rider to crash or get hurt.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your reflexes and reaction time slow down.
Your judgment of speed and distance becomes unclear.
You stay calm and can focus better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You stay calm and can focus better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, affects your vision, changes how you judge speed and distance, and makes you more likely to take risks. It does not help you stay calm or focus.

questions.question: At what blood alcohol level can a driver under 21 be charged with drunk driving?
questions.explanation: Drivers under 21 can be charged if their blood alcohol level is between 0.02 and 0.08 percent. This can result in a license suspension from 60 days to two years.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of roadwork.
Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp turn. You should slow down as much as you would at an intersection turn.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop your car?
questions.explanation: Road condition greatly affects your stopping ability. On slippery or poor roads, you must slow down to stay in control and stop safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to allow the merging traffic to join safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or bike path area. Drive carefully because bicycles often cross or ride beside traffic here.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill or incline with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb. This stops your car from rolling into traffic. If there is no curb, turn the wheels sharply toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Has the same meaning as a circular red traffic light.
Means that drivers may turn in the direction indicated by the arrow.
Means that the traffic the arrow is pointing toward must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Has the same meaning as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a red traffic light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that shows a traffic law. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, which side should a pedestrian walk on?

options.text: Side of the road which has the lightest traffic.
Same side of the road on which traffic is moving.
Side of the road facing oncoming traffic.
Side of the road which has the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side of the road facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed you can travel on a road under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed you can travel on a road under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed to travel on a road under ideal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed you can travel on a road under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the maximum or minimum legal speed on a road under ideal conditions. You can drive slower than the posted speed, but you cannot drive faster. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, or when weather or road conditions make it unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?
questions.explanation: Brown signs mark areas for recreation, culture, and history. They help you find these places in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment if one side of your car is higher than the other.
You may damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if water is on the shoulder.
You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not slam the brakes or steer sharply. This will cause you to lose control. Instead, ease back onto the road carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if cars are coming toward you.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used on a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a yellow circular light.
Drivers may turn in the direction of the arrow.
A green arrow is about to appear.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow has the same meaning as a yellow light. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When may you pass on the right shoulder?

options.text: When the car in front is turning.
When the car in front is going too slowly.

questions.explanation: You can never drive on the shoulder to pass. Driving off the pavement onto the shoulder is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is always on top and green on the bottom. On horizontal signals, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What should you do if your right wheels leave the road?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back onto the road fast.
Release the gas pedal, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the gas pedal, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: Don't panic. Release the gas pedal and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and ease back onto the pavement with a small turn of the wheel. Use both hands on the steering wheel. Check for traffic before getting back on the road.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
